slides.h1: You get 100 characters of keywords. Don't waste them.
slides.lead: The hidden field in App Store Connect that decides what you show up for.

slides.h2: Skip words already in your name and subtitle.
slides.lead: They already count. Repeating them burns space for nothing.
Every space is a character you could have used for a real word.
Not your feature names. The plain words someone uses when the problem hits.

slides.h2: Features get you approved. Keywords get you found.
slides.lead: Spend ten minutes on this field before you submit.
